achievements.title: Opening Number
achievements.quip: Everyone remembers their first. The enemy, briefly.

achievements.title: Not a Scratch
achievements.description: Clear a room of enemies without taking damage.
achievements.quip: Clean work. The janitors appreciate it.

achievements.title: Technically Alive
achievements.description: Clear a room with exactly 1 HP left.
achievements.quip: Technically alive is the best kind of alive.

achievements.title: Photo Finish
achievements.description: Clear a floor with 2 or fewer ticks left.
achievements.quip: The ceiling missed you by a rounding error.

achievements.title: Exit Interview
achievements.quip: Please return your keycard and any remaining optimism.

achievements.title: Untouchable
achievements.description: Clear a floor without taking any damage.
achievements.quip: The monsters are reviewing the footage frame by frame.

achievements.title: No Takebacks
achievements.description: Clear a floor without re-entering a room.
achievements.quip: Commitment issues? Never heard of them.

achievements.title: Express Elevator
achievements.description: Clear a floor in under 90 seconds.
achievements.quip: Speed is a virtue. So is not dying. Pick one.

achievements.title: Unboxing Video
achievements.quip: Like, subscribe, and do not ask about the drop rates.

achievements.title: Devout-ish
achievements.quip: The shrine accepts ticks, blood and vague hope.

achievements.title: Union Break
achievements.quip: Mandated rest period observed. Grudgingly.

achievements.title: Rubble Rouser
achievements.quip: The floor fell. You declined to.

achievements.title: Down to the Wire
achievements.description: Defeat a boss with 20% HP or less.
achievements.quip: Thrilling for everyone except your health bar.

achievements.title: Middle Management
achievements.quip: More responsibility. Same number of hit points, roughly.

achievements.title: Basement Tenant
achievements.quip: Rent is cheaper down here. So is life.

achievements.title: Subterranean Executive
achievements.quip: Corner office. No windows. Many teeth.

achievements.title: Quarterly Quota
achievements.quip: Productivity is up. Population is down.

achievements.title: Untouched Ten
achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies in a row without taking damage.
achievements.quip: Monsters are now advised to travel in larger groups.

achievements.title: Door Enthusiast
achievements.description: Walk through 25 doors in one run.
achievements.quip: The doors have filed a complaint.

achievements.title: Rodent Review
achievements.description: Die on floor 1 to a rat.
achievements.quip: The rat will be telling this story for weeks.

achievements.title: Structural Feedback
achievements.description: Get caught in a floor collapse.
achievements.quip: Your notes on the building have been forwarded.

achievements.title: Career Exterminator
achievements.quip: Long-service award. No pension.

achievements.title: Loyalty Program
achievements.quip: Your loyalty card is full. It is redeemable for nothing.
